artworks.title: The Fall of Phaeton
artworks.description: Rubens' tumbling chariot — Phaethon struck from the sky while the horses bolt and the world burns beneath Ovid's most catastrophic hubris.

artworks.title: Phaeton
artworks.description: Moreau's watercolour plunges Phaethon through a jewelled abyss of horses and stars — the fatal ride as Symbolist catastrophe. Watercolour on paper; Musée Gustave Moreau, Paris.

artworks.title: Phaeton
artworks.description: Redon isolates Phaethon's fall in a dreamlike swirl of horse and youth — hubris behind the sun-wheel reduced to a single, vertiginous vision.

artworks.title: Helios and Phaeton with Saturn and the Four Seasons
artworks.description: Poussin stages the petition before the fall: Phaethon before Helios amid Saturn and the Seasons — the fatal request that will burn the world. Oil on canvas, Gemäldegalerie, Berlin.

artworks.title: The Fall of Phaëton
artworks.description: Stubbs, the anatomist of horses, paints Phaethon's team thrashing as the chariot breaks — the sun-ride as equine panic and mortal overreach. Oil on canvas, National Trust, Saltram House.

popCulture.title: Metamorphoses
popCulture.creator: Ovid
popCulture.description: Book 2 — Phaethon's ride in Helios' chariot, the scorched earth, and Zeus' thunderbolt: hubris written across the sky.

popCulture.title: Phaethon
popCulture.description: The boy who could not hold the sun — still the name for reckless ambition that burns the world.
